question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on, till the topmost floor is numbered 6. B lives on an even numbered floor but not 6. The sum of floors on which F and B live is 7. D lives immediately above C. The sum of floors on which B and E live is 3. How many people live below D?
